# python-friendly-error-messages

Vendored from `@raspberrypifoundation/python-friendly-error-messages@0.8.0`.

- Source: https://github.com/RaspberryPiFoundation/python-friendly-error-messages
- Licence: Apache 2.0, see `LICENSE` in this directory.
- File: `index.browser.js` is the package's browser build, unmodified. It bundles
  the English copydeck, which is why there is no separate JSON asset here.

The site has no build step and must work offline, so the file is committed rather
than fetched at runtime.

Nothing in this directory should be edited. To update, replace the file from a
newer release and update the version above.
